cohort: Pregnant women from the Taiwan National Health Insurance Research Database (NHIRD), including 29,013 with newly diagnosed PIH and 116,052 matched controls without PIH
finding: Women with PIH have an increased risk of having infants who develop TTN compared to those without PIH.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was identified as an independent risk factor for TTN.
gest_age: Mentioned (preterm birth was a risk factor for TTN)
